workstream: O07 stable object bounds and draw ranges
state: historical O07 bounds/draw-range foundation; follow-on culling/shared-mesh evidence is in measurements-o07-culling.json

checks.range_invariants: Ranges are contiguous, preserve scene object/material IDs, and cover the complete emitted vertex buffer.
checks.bounds_invariants: Each finite AABB contains every emitted world-space position in its range; GLB node transforms are included.

limits: Bounds are derived from emitted vertices, not from an analytic primitive definition.
Empty ranges and ranges containing non-finite positions have no bounds and must be treated as uncullable.
This capture was verified on M1 Max/Metal only; native-window and Windows DX12 rendering remain unverified.
Follow-on camera/light culling and shared instancing are reported separately in measurements-o07-culling.json.
